snippet.title: FEAR OF SLEEP | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
Fear of Sleep is a retro sci-fi survival horror game developed by a AAA weapons artist. Descend into the MetroBunker, survive grotesque monsters, and uncover the tragic mysteries buried in its depths. Face your Maker. Level 1 demo out now. https://store.steampowered.com/app/4008240/FEAR_OF_SLEEP/
---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
